subject: joule v0.1.10 — pipeline activation handoff + K3 pin path + file-layer map
opening: v0.1.10 ships real multi-donor activation commitments on the infer bus (not empty non-tail ACKs), a documented file↔layer map for Kimi-K3, and a pin script so operators can replace synthetic MANIFEST digests with real safetensors hashes without f00 hosting weights.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: Non-tail shards produce domain-separated activation_hex handoffs; the tail verifies the full upstream set before generation. Synthetic kimi-k3-shards digests remain fail-closed in CI; real digests after pin-k3-shards.sh may unlock when content is staged. Placement model_layers stays pinned to verified meta (93).

sections.heading: Added
sections.body: joule_cluster::pipeline activation helpers; ShardActivation on InferRequest/InferDone; docs/design/k3-file-layer-map-v0.md; scripts/pin-k3-shards.sh.

sections.heading: Changed
sections.body: Control and mesh infer fanout is two-phase. quant_can_unlock_service_digests refuses only synthetic digests (not the quant id forever).

sections.heading: Not claimed
sections.body: Full floating-point tensor pipeline-parallel K3 across donors is not claimed. CI still does not download multi-hundred-GB weights.

sections.heading: Verification
sections.body: cargo test --workspace; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --all -- --check.
